reason: FaceQ/F-Bench collects human preference ratings for generated, customized and restored faces; F-Eval is a multimodal evaluator. Evaluation compares 29 face models and image-quality metrics. Its contribution is face-quality measurement, not model inference efficiency; the linked KV-cache lineage does not establish a technical connection.
title: F-Bench: Rethinking Human Preference Evaluation Metrics for Benchmarking Face Generation, Customization, and Restoration
